The opportunity

Great stock, invisible online.

Right now, buyers searching "used cars Newton Park" or "bakkie Eastern Cape" can't find you — because there's no website to find. That's not a cost problem. It's a visibility problem, and it's leaving money on the table.

No website = no Google traffic

When someone searches "used cars near me" from Newton Park, they'll find dealers who have websites. Without one, you're invisible to the biggest source of car buyers in SA.

91% of SA car buyers start their search online — AutoTrader Insights 2025

AutoTrader isn't enough

AutoTrader is a listing portal — you're one of thousands. A dealer website is your own shopfront: your brand, your stock, your finance tools, your leads — all in your control.

Dealers with own websites get 3x more direct enquiries than portal-only listings

Manual work eats your day

Uploading stock to portals one at a time, managing leads from WhatsApp, doing paperwork by hand. TruDMS automates the lot — so you can focus on selling cars.

Average dealer saves 8+ hours/week with centralised inventory management

Every missed lead = missed revenue

A buyer who can't find you at 9pm on a Sunday goes to someone else. A website with finance calculators keeps working 24/7 — generating leads while you sleep.

42% of online vehicle enquiries happen outside business hours
